$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFQJ (AIP France, chart dated 2025-12-25): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.

A "fr" object holds the French column of the same chart, copied as printed and never translated: a French note sits at the index of its English twin and is left empty when the twin could not be paired with certainty; the French of the procedures and of the points' purposes is not recorded.
name: Maubeuge - Élesmes

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked
source.frenchExtraction: French column of the chart text, read by script and paired with the English sentences

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Simultaneous use of paved RWY and unpaved RWY (800 x 80 m) prohibited.
Paved RWY reserved for ACFT and multi-axis class ULM.
Unpaved RWY (800 x 80 m) reserved for homebased ACFT.
When the unpaved RWYs are not available (NOTAM), all activities are transferred on paved RWY.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
TWY A and C restricted: to ACFT with wingspan lower than 24 m; to ACFT with overall width of main landing gear lower than 6 m.
Half-turn axial mark cannot be used on THR 05.
TKOF runways 23: turn left as soon as possible heading 213° and avoid the city of Assevent and the prison (QDR 218° / 1.5 NM).
Parachuting activity (NR 271): see AIP ENR 5.5 Aerobatics activity (NR 6030): see AIP ENR 5.5 AEM (NR 8287): see AIP ENR 5.5.
HEL, ballons and hot-air ballons activity possible on AD.
Paramotor activity close to the drop zone.
If paramotor activity, unpaved 300x20 m strip closed.
AD réservé aux ACFT munis de radio.
Utilisation simultanée piste revêtue et non revêtue (800 x 80 m) interdite.
Piste revêtue réservée aux avions et ULM classe multiaxes.
Piste non revêtue (800 x 80 m) réservée aux aéronefs basés.
Quand les pistes non revêtues sont inutilisables (NOTAM), toutes les activités sont reportées sur la piste revêtue.
Roulage interdit hors RWY et TWY.
TWY A et C limités : aux ACFT d'envergure inférieure à 24 m ; aux ACFT dont la largeur hors tout du train principal est inférieure à 6 m.
La bande axiale de demi-tour n'est plus utilisée sur le seuil 05.

Parachutage (N° 271) : voir AIP ENR 5.5 Voltige (N° 6030) : voir AIP ENR 5.5 AEM (N° 8287) : voir AIP ENR 5.5 Activités HEL, ballons et montgolfières possibles sur AD.
